meta.titulo: Edge Build Labs — built by AI agents, proven before delivered
meta.imagemAlt: The step symbol, in cream and gold, beside the Edge Build Labs wordmark, on a near-black background.
meta.descricao: Video for social media and YouTube — short vertical and long-form narrated, faceless — and automation with AI agents, under a contract that makes the agent prove its work. Made by one person, Evandro Henn, in Brazil, full time.

heroi.sub: Evandro Henn — one person, in Brazil, full time, with a fleet of agents on his own server.

caminhos.contrato: Scope, deadline and price agreed in writing.

cartoes.titulo: Video for social media and YouTube
cartoes.texto: Voice-over, music, effects and on-screen text. Two lines: short vertical up to 60 seconds, in the network's format, and long-form narrated, faceless, 10 to 20 minutes, ready for YouTube.
itens: Script from your brief, or editing from the script you bring
One revision round on the pilot, two after that
First cut in 3 calendar days for short, 5 for long-form, from the brief

cartoes.texto: Routines, integrations and agents that work on their own — and leave a receipt of what they did. The contract is public; scope and price come in the proposal.
itens: Every run records what ran, when, and what came back
Runs on your server or on Edge Build Labs' own
Delivered with the evidence contract applied

prova.lead: Things a stranger can open and check.
prova.videoAviso: The video loads from YouTube only after you click.

videos.texto: Script, voice-over and editing done with agents; rendered locally in Remotion. In Portuguese.
Real captures of the site and the site's own artwork; Remotion type; synthetic voice-over. No generated imagery, no real people. In Portuguese.
From raw footage to finished video: cuts on the beat of the speech, captions, sound effects and licensed music, in 9:16. Stock footage; synthetic voice-over. In Portuguese.
The whole long-form line, made here: script, images, voice-over, editing, music and captions. Faceless, with the source on screen for every claim. Own piece, no client. In Portuguese.

itens.texto: A public Ultima Online shard (T2A era, on ModernUO), running since 5 September 2026 on a single VPS. Rootless container, image pinned by digest, daily backup with a restore that was actually performed.
Three public-domain files (CC0), no dependencies, no install. Copy one into your repository: it is the instruction set that makes your agent report what it ran, when, and what came back.
How to ask for the work so that proof is possible: goal, state, scope, acceptance, limits, evidence and stop. A public-domain template (CC0).

How you talk to an agent running on a machine you do not control, and how its delivery outlives the session: a repository used as a channel, with the contract inside it. Extracted from a channel that ran for six days with five agents. Public domain (CC0).

escada.lead: Four words an agent confuses. Not here.

degraus.texto: The process began. That is all.
The agent says it is done. That is a sentence, not a fact.
Someone read the result off the machine: the file, the log, the test.
What was asked matches what was delivered, with a source and a date.

escada.regra: Every claim of state carries a source and a date, or the words

faixa.texto: Running agents on real infrastructure? The whole method is on the thesis site.

contato.titulo: Say by e-mail what you need and by when. In writing, no calls.
contato.quem: The brief is read, answered and signed off by Evandro Henn.

blocos.html: This site started from the blackspike astro landing page by blackspike design, under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. The unused sections were cut, and the typeface, colours and components replaced; the Astro + Tailwind structure and the CSS scroll animations come from there. The license text ships with the source code.

Source Serif 4, version 4.004, © 2014 The Source Serif 4 Project Authors (Adobe), under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Served from this site as WOFF2 with the font data unchanged, compression only (OFL FAQ, item 2.2.1). The original TTF sits next to the license; sha256 97b2d4da6e3cb494…, copied from google/fonts on 18 September 2026.
Astro and Tailwind CSS, both MIT, used only to generate the HTML. The published site is static: neither runs in your browser.

Symbol, wordmark, copy and videos are Edge Build Labs' own. The video covers are frames from the videos themselves. The player loads from YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com) only after you click; until then nothing leaves this server.
